77:1: And those sent one after another.
77:4: Then to those separating as they separate.
77:7: Indeed, what is promised to you will surely happen.
77:8: When the stars are wiped out.
77:9: When the sky is cleft asunder.
77:10: When the mountains are uprooted and cast away.
77:11: When the time is appointed for the messengers.
77:12: For which day has it been postponed?
77:14: And what made you know what the Day of Separation is?
77:15: Woe on that day to the deniers!
77:16: Did We not destroy the former ones?
77:17: Then We cause the later ones to follow them.
77:18: Thus We do to the criminals.
77:19: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:20: Did We not create you from a humble water?
77:21: We placed it in a firm place.
77:23: We determined, and how excellent determiners We are.
77:24: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:25: Did We not make the earth a gathering place?
77:26: Did We not make the earth a gathering place for the living and the dead?
77:27: And We made high mountains therein and gave you sweet water to drink.
77:28: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:29: Depart to that which you used to deny.
77:30: Depart to a shadow having three branches.
77:31: Neither giving shade nor availing against the flame.
77:32: Indeed, it throws sparks like palaces.
77:33: As if it were yellow camels.
77:34: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:35: This is the day they will not speak.
77:36: And they are not permitted to make excuses.
77:37: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:38: This is the Day of Separation in which We have gathered you and the former ones.
77:39: If you have a plot, then plot against Me.
77:40: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:41: Indeed, the people of taqwa are in shades and springs.
77:42: And from fruits, whatever they desire.
77:43: Eat and drink with relish in return for what you used to do.
77:44: Indeed, thus We reward the doers of good.
77:45: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:46: Eat and enjoy for a little while, indeed you are criminals.
77:47: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:48: When it is said to them, 'Make ruku!', they do not make ruku.
77:49: Woe on that day to the deniers.
77:50: Then after it, in what statement will they believe?
